## Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.
A clear and concise description of what the problem or limitation is. (e.g. "I want to route specific devices through NextDNS or Pi-hole instead of AdGuard Home...")

## Describe the solution you'd like
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've evaluated.

## Target Hardware & OpenWrt Release
- **Target Router Architecture**: (e.g. ARM64, MIPS MT7621, x86_64)
- **OpenWrt Release**: (e.g. 23.05, 24.x)

## Additional context
Add any other context, UCI configuration snippets, or screenshots about the feature request here.
